# MyWellnessCalc

> MyWellnessCalc is a free wellness calculator and health information site. It provides accurate, research-backed calculators, articles, and quizzes covering fitness, nutrition, body composition, sleep, and lifestyle health.

## Quiz Index
- [All Wellness Quizzes](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/): 19 short quizzes that match users to evidence-based protocols across nutrition, fitness, body composition, and lifestyle.

## Quizzes

### Nutrition
- [What's Your Ideal Fasting Protocol?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/ideal-fasting-protocol.html): 5-question quiz matching users to the best intermittent fasting schedule based on lifestyle, hunger tolerance, and goals.
- [Are You Getting Enough Protein?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/enough-protein.html): Assesses daily protein intake against bodyweight, activity level, and goals.
- [Are You Eating the Right Macros?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/right-macros.html): Evaluates whether protein, carb, and fat balance fits the user's current fitness goal.
- [Do You Need to Supplement Vitamin D?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/vitamin-d-supplement.html): Based on sun exposure, diet, skin tone, and location — determines if vitamin D supplementation is warranted.

### Fitness
- [What's Your Zone 2 Fitness Level?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/zone-2-fitness-level.html): Assesses aerobic base development from cardio habits, conversational pace, and resting heart rate — matches to a Zone 2 training plan.
- [What's Your Training Zone?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/training-zone.html): Identifies the appropriate heart rate training zone (Zone 2, mixed, or active recovery) based on fitness level and goals.
- [Should You Try MAF Training?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/maf-training.html): Evaluates whether the Maffetone low-heart-rate method suits the user's goals and mindset.
- [What Type of Cardio Suits You?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/cardio-type.html): Recommends Zone 2, HIIT, or a mixed approach based on goals, time availability, and fitness level.
- [Is Creatine Right for You?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/creatine-right-for-you.html): Assesses whether creatine supplementation aligns with training type, diet, and goals.

### Body & Weight
- [What's Your Muscle-Building Starting Point?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/muscle-building-starting-point.html): Identifies beginner, intermediate, or advanced muscle-building stage from training history, muscle definition, and body fat — links to FFMI tracking.
- [What's Your Body Goal Type?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/body-goal-type.html): Distinguishes between fat loss, muscle building, and recomposition goals with targeted starting advice.
- [What's Your Fat Loss Strategy?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/fat-loss-strategy.html): Recommends a personalised fat loss approach based on body composition, eating habits, and training history.
- [Are You at a Healthy BMI?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/healthy-bmi.html): Contextualises BMI and explains when alternative measures (body fat %, waist-to-hip ratio) are more meaningful.
- [What's Your Ideal Weight Loss Rate?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/weight-loss-rate.html): Recommends a sustainable weekly loss target based on starting weight, hunger tolerance, and lifestyle.
- [Are You in a Weight Loss Plateau?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/weight-loss-plateau.html): Diagnoses whether a stall is a true plateau, metabolic adaptation, or tracking issue — with targeted solutions.
- [What's Your Metabolism Type?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/metabolism-type.html): Profiles metabolic rate based on age, muscle mass, and activity to explain calorie burn and what to do about it.

### Lifestyle
- [What's Your Recovery Type?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/recovery-type.html): Assesses whether recovery (sleep, stress, deload habits) is keeping pace with training load — with a tailored recovery plan.
- [What's Your Sleep Type?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/sleep-type.html): Identifies morning, evening, or intermediate chronotype with personalised sleep timing recommendations.
- [Are You Drinking Enough Water?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/enough-water.html): Estimates hydration needs based on bodyweight, activity level, and climate.
- [What's Your Ideal Body Weight?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/quiz/ideal-body-weight.html): Explains how to set a realistic goal weight accounting for muscle mass, age, and body frame.



## Tools Index
- [All Health & Fitness Calculators](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/): Directory of all 23 free health and fitness calculators with search functionality.

## Calculators

### Body & Weight
- [BMI Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/bmi-calculator.html): Free BMI calculator. Enter height and weight to find Body Mass Index and understand what it means for health.
- [Body Fat Percentage Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/body-fat-calculator.html): Estimates body fat percentage using the U.S. Navy method with a tape measure — no calipers needed.
- [Ideal Body Weight Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/ideal-weight.html): Calculates healthy weight range based on height using four medical formulas: Devine, Robinson, Miller, and Hamwi.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/lean-body-mass-calculator.html): Estimates lean body mass (fat-free mass) using the Boer formula from height, weight, and gender. Shows fat mass and body composition breakdown.
- [Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator.html): Calculates waist-to-hip ratio and health risk level based on WHO guidelines. Supports cm and inches.

### Nutrition
- [Calorie & TDEE Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/calorie-calculator.html): Calculates Total Daily Energy Expenditure based on age, weight, height, and activity level.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/calorie-deficit-calculator.html): Calculates daily calorie target for fat loss based on TDEE, goal weight, and weekly loss rate — with safety rating and protein target.
- [Calorie Surplus Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/calorie-surplus-calculator.html): Calculates daily calorie target for muscle gain based on TDEE, goal weight, weekly gain rate, and training experience — with a fat-gain assessment and protein target.
- [Lean Bulk vs Dirty Bulk: Which Actually Builds More Muscle?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/lean-bulk-vs-dirty-bulk.html): Side-by-side comparison of lean and dirty bulking — surplus size, muscle-to-fat ratio, and which approach holds up better a year later.
- [Macro Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/macro-calculator.html): Finds ideal daily protein, carbohydrate, and fat targets based on calories, body weight, and fitness goals.
- [Protein Intake Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/protein-calculator.html): Calculates optimal daily protein target based on weight, activity level, and goals — muscle building, fat loss, or maintenance.
- [Protein Calculator for Women Over 40](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/protein-calculator-women-over-40.html): Personalised daily protein target for women over 40 based on weight, activity level, and goals.
- [Vitamin D Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/vitamin-d-calculator.html): Calculates daily Vitamin D needs based on age, sun exposure, skin tone, and lifestyle.

### Fitness & Heart Rate
- [Heart Rate Zone Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/heart-rate-zone.html): Calculates all 5 training heart rate zones for fat burn, cardio, and peak performance based on age and resting heart rate.
- [Zone 2 Heart Rate Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/zone-2-calculator.html): Finds exact Zone 2 training range for fat burning and aerobic base building using age and resting heart rate.
- [MAF Heart Rate Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/maf-calculator.html): Calculates Maximum Aerobic Function heart rate using the Maffetone 180 Formula, adjusted for individual health and training status.
- [Active Recovery Heart Rate Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/active-recovery-calculator.html): Calculates Zone 1 active recovery heart rate range — the low-intensity ceiling for rest-day movement that promotes circulation without adding training stress.
- [Calories Burned by Heart Rate Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/calories-burned-by-heart-rate.html): Calculates calories burned based on heart rate, age, weight, and workout duration.
- [One Rep Max Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/one-rep-max.html): Estimates maximum lift (1RM) for bench press, squat, deadlift and more using proven formulas with training percentages.
- [Running Pace Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/running-pace.html): Calculates finish time, required pace, or distance for any race — 5K, 10K, half marathon, or marathon.

### Lifestyle
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/water-intake.html): Personalised daily water intake recommendation based on weight, activity level, and climate.
- [Sleep Cycle Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/sleep-calculator.html): Finds the best bedtime or wake-up time aligned with natural 90-minute sleep cycles.
- [Intermittent Fasting Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/if-calculator.html): Sets fasting protocol (16:8, 18:6, 20:4, 5:2) and calculates exact eat and fast windows for any start time.
- [Fasting Timer](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/fasting-timer.html): Real-time fasting tracker. Shows elapsed time, progress through fasting stages, and countdown to eating window.
- [Intermittent Fasting Calculator for Women](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/if-calculator-women.html): Personalised fasting window for women based on lifestyle, hormonal phase, and goals.

- [What Is Metabolism — And Can You Actually Boost It?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/what-is-metabolism.html): How metabolism works, what affects it, and which metabolism boosters are backed by evidence.

### Body & Health
- [FFMI Calculator](https://mywellnesscalc.com/tools/ffmi-calculator.html): Calculate your Fat-Free Mass Index and normalized FFMI from weight, height, and body fat percentage — a better measure of muscularity than BMI.
- [What Is FFMI? The Muscle Index BMI Doesn't Show You](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/what-is-ffmi.html): What FFMI measures, how it's calculated, what counts as a good score, and how it differs from BMI.
- [FFMI vs BMI: Which Should Lifters Actually Trust?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/ffmi-vs-bmi.html): A direct comparison of FFMI and BMI — when each metric is useful and where each one falls short.
- [What Is a Healthy BMI?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/what-is-a-healthy-bmi.html): What a healthy BMI range is, what the number tells you, and how to use it wisely.
- [What Is a Healthy Body Fat Percentage?](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/healthy-body-fat-percentage.html): Healthy body fat ranges for men and women, and how to measure accurately.
- [How to Lose Belly Fat: What the Science Actually Says](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/how-to-lose-belly-fat.html): What the research says about losing abdominal fat — what works and what doesn't.
- [How to Break a Weight Loss Plateau](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/weight-loss-plateau.html): Why weight loss plateaus happen and evidence-based strategies to start losing again.
- [Why You Hit a Weight Loss Plateau and How to Break It](https://mywellnesscalc.com/blog/why-weight-loss-plateau-how-to-break-it.html): Why plateaus happen despite eating well and exercising, and how to get moving again.
